Academic portal submission for supervisor onboarding

Supervisor Details

Complete the form carefully. Required fields are marked with an asterisk.

Address

Use the structured institutional address in the same template as the student portal.

Upload policy

Only PDF files are accepted. Maximum file size is 5 MB. The upload preview below is a frontend-only indicator.

Your details will be reviewed by the postgraduate research office.

Supervisor Guidelines

Please review before submitting

  • Use your official academic or institutional details exactly as they appear in your records.
  • Upload a single PDF curriculum vitae that is 5 MB or smaller.
  • Ensure the telephone number is reachable and formatted for Sri Lanka.
  • Provide a professional email address that you actively monitor.

Submission Steps

Front-end workflow preview

  1. 1Complete every required field and review the upload preview before submission.
  2. 2Use the sticky submit button to send the form once all details are accurate.
  3. 3A confirmation toast will appear after submission is accepted by the frontend.
